name: Vegan Sausage with Maple-Chili Brussels Sprouts & Carrots over Rice
instructions: Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a medium saucepan. Add water and salt, then bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.

Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, add the sausages, cover the saucepan, and reduce the heat to low. Cook the rice until sausages are warmed through and the liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove from the heat and let stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Peel, trim, and cut carrots lengthwise into quarters, then crosswise into 2-inch long pieces; transfer to a large baking sheet pan.
Trim and halve Brussels sprouts; add to the baking sheet with the carrots. Drizzle with oil, season with spices, and toss to combine; spread out in an even layer.
Place baking sheet in the oven and roast, tossing once, until veggies are fork-tender, about 15 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, juice lime into a small bowl; add maple syrup and chili-garlic sauce. Whisk to combine the maple-chili glaze.
When the veggies are done, drizzle with the glaze and toss to combine. Return to the oven and continue to roast until caramelized, 4-5 minutes more. Remove from oven.
When the rice is done, carefully transfer the sausages to a cutting board and allow them to cool slightly. Cut in half lengthwise, then slice crosswise into ½-inch thick half-moons.
To serve, divide rice, veggies, and sausage between plates or bowls. Enjoy!
author: Mealime
